name: short-slide-right
title: Short Slide Right
description: The whole phrase glides in from the left while words reveal in sequence through opacity.
useWhen: A short headline should enter with horizontal momentum that reads as forward motion or progress.
Word-level opacity stagger is layered on a single group translation.
avoidWhen: You are transitioning between two texts: use shared-axis-z or shared-axis-y.
You want vertical stacking motion: use short-slide-down.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far left of its place the phrase starts.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Frames between each word's fade (30 fps).

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
